title: Chapter 457 Deep Foundation
content:
Chapter 457 Deep Foundation

Boom boom boom boom!

The huge momentum shattered the starry sky, and tens of millions of terrifying troops came towards the battlefield with uniform steps, surging momentum.

At the forefront of the army, a huge flag fluttered wildly and roared.

And above the battle flag, there is a conspicuous word "Lu".

Lu Family Army!

"kill!"

The leader was wearing purple gold armor, holding a big sword, and his body was filled with a terrifying murderous aura, which made everyone on the battlefield feel silent.

It is the commander of the Lu family army, the God of War Yunqi!

With the arrival of the Lu family army, the entire battlefield completely established a victory.

The sentient beings in the Chaos Realm looked dull and fell into a violent state with a huge increase in combat power. The powerful man from another world who was washed away by this huge force and was defeated.

Is this the real strength of Huangcheng?

Their efforts in the Chaos Realm for so many years seem so ridiculous in front of the power of the wasteland city.

Some powerful men in other worlds have regained their rationality, but are more occupied by fear and started to escape. They have placed their targets on the black hole that teleported them.

The huge black hole still stands in the starry sky and does not disappear.

The defeated creatures in other worlds began to rush towards the black hole, trying to withdraw from the land of the gods.

Seeing this, the powerful men in the Chaos Realm immediately shouted anxiously, "No, they want to escape, stop them quickly!"

However, the strong men in the deserted city seemed to have not seen it, and watched the defeated strong men from other worlds surge into the black hole and flee along the original passage.

This scene made the strong man in the Chaos Realm stomp his feet, "If you don't drive out all the kills, it's like letting the tiger go back to the mountain!"

The head of the Holy Spirit clan also frowned, "Once the land of the gods recovers, it will inevitably make a comeback."

The leader of the Tian Yao tribe was covered in blood and his brows were also frowning at this moment.

In response, Lu Xue sneered, "Recover? They have no chance, because today is the day when the land of the gods perishes!"

Buzz —

At this moment, a strong sense of space vibration came.

Several familiar figures also came one after another.

A beautiful woman emerged and glanced at the audience, and suddenly she frowned slightly, "Huh? Is it over?"

Seeing this woman, Lu Xue smiled and said, "Sister Ouyang, you are late."

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing was suddenly a little disappointed.

"You're the one who took the lead."

At this time, Qin Yi, Mu Chen, and the divine generals under Yan Lingyun also appeared in the field one by one. Seeing that the creatures in another world had basically been solved, they immediately smiled helplessly.

Lu Xue looked at the familiar people and no longer had the anxiety at the beginning of the war.

But suddenly, Lu Xue looked at Yu Qingfeng and said in confusion: "Senior Qingfeng, why haven't Senior Jiangbei arrived?"

She remembered that all the people under Lu Daosheng had returned, but she had not seen Jiang Bei.

At this time, everyone also looked at Yu Qingfeng.

Could it be that Jiangbei encountered some trouble?

Feeling the inquiring eyes of everyone, Yu Qingfeng laughed, "That guy has already gone straight to the base camp of the Land of Gods."

"What!"

Everyone was shocked.

This credit cannot be taken away by Jiangbei alone.

At this time, the remnants of the land of Gods had retreated and the black hole dissipated.

In desperation, everyone quickly worked together to open a space passage to the land of the gods.

Suddenly, the strong men in the deserted city flocked in directly, fearing that they would be left behind.

In a moment, only the creatures in the Chaos Realm, Lu Xue and Ao Qing were left on the scene.

The messy battlefield everywhere reminds everyone that a great war broke out here not long ago.

The void was filled with a strong smell of blood.

The remaining limbs and flesh floated freely, and everyone looked at the starry sky and the surviving comrades, with a little dullness in their eyes.

This is actually over.

The Chaos Realm is held.

But it doesn't seem to have much to do with them either.

Even Wu Hui, the contemporary hall master of the Human Emperor Palace, was a little surprised.

There is a heaven beyond the sky. How powerful is it to truly stand out in the world?

Perhaps, it's only that adult.

At this moment, Lu Xue's voice suddenly rang out in the audience and came into everyone's ears.

"Anyone of you wishes to go with me and completely destroy the land of the gods."

Hearing this, all the people present were stunned.

After the battle just now, the strong men were more or less injured, and even worse, they had already died in the hands of the strong men in another world, sprinkling blood in the void.

Now the land of the gods has receded, and the strong men from the deserted city have gone to the land of the gods to completely end.

The most correct way to do it now should be to integrate the remaining strength in your hands to rest and recuperate.

only,,

Wu Hui looked at Lu Xue, and he knew that the reason why Lu Xue was still here was waiting for them.

Without hesitation, Wu Hui said directly: "Lord Lu Xue, Wu Hui is willing to go with you!"

"Okay." Lu Xue nodded, looked at Wu Hui with admiration, and then looked at the other strong men, "Is there any more?"

Seeing the human leader Wu Hui set an example, the other human powerhouses gritted their teeth and stepped forward and said, "Lord Lu Xue, and we."

Seeing the human race, the leader of the Tian Yao clan and the leader of the Holy Spirit clan looked at each other, and they both saw a sense of determination and a strong bloodiness in each other's eyes.

The land of the gods is so domineering that they regard their Chaos Realm as ants. Do you really think they have no temper?

The enemy will go, and I can go!

Let the land of gods taste the taste of being invaded!

With the statements of the three powerful clans, the other strong men with tone expressed their willingness to go with them.

Lu Xue laughed loudly, "Then let us kill all the so-called gods together!"

"kill!"

.........

Rumble!

Above the sky of the land of the gods, a figure kept waving his fists, opening and closing, fighting against the gods.

"Hahahaha, is the so-called god the only one who has the ability?"

The God of Martial Arts Jiang Bei laughed loudly and was full of energy.

But the god who was fighting against him was angry and shocked. He couldn't understand why such a powerful creature suddenly appeared in this world.

"Who are you? Why did you offend me the land of the gods?"

The gods were furious.

Jiang Bei punched out, knocking the gods back tens of thousands of miles, and smiled arrogantly, "Your grandpa Jiang Bei is that, as for why, haha, you gods have messed with the wrong person!"

Provoke the wrong person?

The other gods exchanged ideas and immediately understood.

"It must be him!"

"Damn it, that guy has been in the dark and plotting against my gods. Unexpectedly, he could invite such a strong man."

The god was shocked and hated the person behind the scenes to the core.

"Fellow Daoist, maybe there may be a misunderstanding between us."

A pillar of light shines through the sky, and a creature bathing in the divine light came out of it.

"Yes, what good does that man give you? I can give you twice as much as the Land of Gods."

The god who was confronting Jiangbei also spoke.

The pressure to confront Jiangbei is too great. If you can recruit such a strong man, it will definitely be a huge benefit to the Land of Gods.

In their opinion, Jiangbei only suffered some benefits to deal with the land of gods.

Interests are paramount, and no matter how powerful an existence is, it will pay attention to interests.

They constantly invade the land of gods, and manage for endless years, with a profound foundation, and think that the person behind them is worthy.
